eyebrow.zh: 定好规则 · 全本地 · 手机审批
eyebrow.en: Set the rules · Fully local · Phone approvals

headline.zh:
信得过的命令自动放行
该问你的还进手机一个队列
headline.en:
Trusted commands pass on their own
— the rest still queue on your phone

sub.zh: 写一条「make *: 放行」这样的规则，匹配上的提示直接答掉、不再弹手机，没匹配上的还照旧进手机队列一条条来——该拦的拦，该放行的别再麻烦你。
sub.en: Write a rule like 'make *: approve' and matching prompts are answered on the spot without a phone tap, while anything that doesn't match still queues on your phone one at a time — block what matters, stop babysitting the safe ones.

title.zh: 信得过的命令，定好规则就自动放行
title.en: Trusted commands pass on their own once you set the rules

body.zh: 哪些命令信得过、可以自动放行，由你定；规则没匹配上、或你想填的选项对不上这条提示，它就老老实实把这条塞回手机队列等你——不会偷偷替你按掉任何该问的事。
body.en: You decide which commands are trusted enough to pass on their own; if a rule doesn't match, or the choice you set isn't on that prompt, it goes back to your phone queue for you — nothing dangerous slips through unattended.

title.zh: 几个 Agent 抢着问 → 手机排一条队
title.en: Several agents asking at once → one phone queue

body.zh: 四个终端里的 Agent 不再各自打断你——所有审批提示聚拢成手机上一个按先后排好的队列，一次只放一个，每条标着是哪个 Agent，扫一眼就知道该回答谁。
body.en: Four agents in four terminals stop interrupting you one at a time — every prompt gathers into one ordered queue on your phone, one at a time, each tagged with which agent, so a glance tells you who to answer.

chips: › Agent 崩了看真实退出码

title.zh: 认得你用的每一个 Agent

body.zh: Claude Code 的方括号提示、Cursor 和 Aider 的 (Y)es/(N)o 提示，它都认得——不用为换个 Agent 就重学一遍；想接新 Agent，加个适配就行。
body.en: Claude Code's bracket prompts, Cursor and Aider's (Y)es/(N)o dialect — it understands all of them, so switching agents doesn't mean relearning; adding a new one is just one adapter.

title.en: Approvals stay on your machine — no cloud

body.zh: 所有进程都跑在你自己的机器上：扫个码就能在手机上审批，审批记录也留在本机——没有 Docker、没有云服务、没有外部数据库。
body.en: Every process runs on your own machine: scan a QR to approve from your phone, with records staying on your machine — no Docker, no cloud service, no external database.

headline.en: Stop tapping through the safe ones

sub.zh: 一条命令起好规则，扫个码连上手机——信得过的自动放行，该问的还进队列。Apache-2.0 开源，全程本地。
sub.en: One command to set the rules, one QR to reach your phone — trusted commands pass on their own, the rest still queue. Apache-2.0 licensed, fully local.

tag.zh: Apache-2.0 开源 · 全程本地
